requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

notes: Runs the pinned original solve constructor with a candidate priority function and an independent exact certificate check. Paper search/model budget is not reproduced.
Uses the published Table 1/2/3 problem dimension, except minimum-maximal uses the n=16 training setting discussed in section 4.2.
Minimum-maximal uses positive cardinality with direction=minimize; this is equivalent to the paper negative-cardinality reward.

limitations: Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
